---
title: "Example Dataset"
---

The group provides a protected practice dataset so new members can run the same analysis and compare their results with an expected output.

| Item | What to provide |
|---|---|
| Raw files | Group storage path and access instructions |
| FASTA | Approved reference database and version |
| Metadata | Sample sheet and description of the experiment |
| Search results | Expected DIA-NN or Spectronaut outputs |
| ProtPipe output | Expected QC and final analysis files |

## Recommended exercise

1. Copy the practice files to your approved working space.
2. Run the documented DIA-NN or Spectronaut test workflow.
3. Compare the key output files with the expected results.
4. Run the corresponding ProtPipe configuration.
5. Discuss unexpected QC results with your mentor.

<div class="callout">
Do not store raw instrument files in GitHub. Store them on approved institutional or Biowulf storage, then link to the location from this page.
</div>
